q: Per molecule of glucose, what is the TOTAL output of the link reaction plus the Krebs cycle?
options: 4 CO2, 6 reduced NAD, 2 reduced FAD, 2 ATP
6 CO2, 8 reduced NAD, 2 reduced FAD, 2 ATP
6 CO2, 6 reduced NAD, 2 reduced FAD, 4 ATP
3 CO2, 4 reduced NAD, 1 reduced FAD, 1 ATP
explanation: One glucose gives 2 pyruvate. Link reaction (per pyruvate): oxidative decarboxylation → acetyl CoA + CO2 + reduced NAD, so 2 CO2 and 2 NADH per glucose. Two Krebs turns add 4 CO2, 6 NADH, 2 FADH2 and 2 ATP. Total: 6 CO2 (all six glucose carbons), 8 NADH, 2 FADH2, 2 ATP – most of the energy is now held in reduced NAD and FAD.
